InvokeAI ER-SDE scheduler

This directory contains an unmodified copy of
invokeai/backend/rectified_flow/er_sde_scheduler.py from InvokeAI commit
9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b:
https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI/blob/9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b/invokeai/backend/rectified_flow/er_sde_scheduler.py

Source SHA-256:
3c18bd6a847fcf0ecf0a6b67c37744546dc4dfbb88a0595915fe2391d437fbd7

Attribution: InvokeAI contributors. Distributed under Apache License 2.0;
the upstream license is included as LICENSE-InvokeAI.txt.

The original module retains its ER-SDE paper and reference implementation
attribution:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06169
https://github.com/QinpengCui/ER-SDE-Solver
The reference repository's MIT notice is included as LICENSE-ER-SDE-Solver.txt.

Only ImageGen Studio's typed Anima flow wrapper selects the admitted configuration.
Third-party VP-SDE modes are not public ImageGen Studio model-family support.
The vendor file is excluded narrowly from local style/type rewriting to preserve
its exact upstream bytes. Application policy and integration wrappers remain
under the project's normal checks. Independent numerical tests load the pinned
external Invoke source and compare actual execution, not this copy as its oracle.

InvokeAI normal outpaint conditioning and LaMa adapter

ImageGen Studio's ../outpaint_conditioning.py and ../lama_infill.py adapt:
invokeai/app/invocations/create_gradient_mask.py
SHA-256: 4cf9673b0935547a043f64c6ecd9b44a83a392fa1de19ee9be2f2ebb0ada0f37
invokeai/app/invocations/image.py (ExpandMaskWithFadeInvocation / ApplyMaskToImageInvocation)
SHA-256: 3f6a9c80649d1fe0185bb48d64cbe27c809c3104d4eaa45946211a615a3ce972
invokeai/backend/image_util/infill_methods/lama.py
SHA-256: 15562f2c69436f02e8934e95bd7de765233e153caa469ca596991ab77baf64cf
All from InvokeAI commit 9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b,
https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI/tree/9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b
Attribution: InvokeAI contributors, Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-InvokeAI.txt).

ImageGen Studio's ../smart_patch_fade.py also reuses the exact external fade
through ../outpaint_conditioning.py's validated binary keep-mask helper.
It adapts source/owned-mask union to a copied binary contribution core, computes
the fade in project pixels before internal scaling, and publishes only a private
numeric contribution plane. Authored soft mask coverage is retained independently.
This pre-coherence geometry is not complete Invoke inpaint/outpaint graph parity,
latent conditioning, generation, accepted pixels or a new inference backend.

ImageGen Studio's ../smart_patch_conditioning.py additionally adapts the three
CreateGradientMaskInvocation coherence modes through the shared copied numeric
keep-mask helper in ../outpaint_conditioning.py. Processing-pixel radius /8,
BILINEAR reduction, F32 weighted MAX, Staged/minimum-denoise selection and uint8
truncation retain the pinned algorithm. The world input combines source/authored
keep before BICUBIC scaling; binary projected world coverage retains the original
edit core and WORLD-pixel fade. These coordinate/core adaptations are explicit,
not full scaled graph parity. No Torch, VAE, infill, model or inference is added
to this private six-plane CPU preparation. Existing normal OUT defaults remain
Gaussian16/minimum0 with their unchanged source-only policy.

Modifications: explicit caller-owned policy, copied RGBA source, CPU NumPy
weighted maximum filter, bounded grid/output guards, descriptor-backed exact
local TorchScript capture, finite output validation, and no remote service,
invocation storage or publication. The shared source-equivalent defaults are
owned by Main; family denoising/public outpaint are not enabled by these modules.
LaMa weights are not bundled in this worker package. The separately pinned
Sanster/models TorchScript release is a Main-owned future engine resource;
this source adaptation notice does not change its separate weight attribution.

InvokeAI masked Illustrious denoising

ImageGen Studio's ../sdxl_outpaint.py adapts AddsMaskGuidance from:
invokeai/backend/stable_diffusion/diffusers_pipeline.py
SHA-256: 23299704c36e969e0b39ac30c469f6c0587605df58ff62573d1c6d83b7784d24
and its mask preparation in invokeai/app/invocations/denoise_latents.py
SHA-256: 0359372b59aee6b1be1ca792e0bab394cc57b915b924cad3ff0e512270863639
Both from InvokeAI commit 9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b,
https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI/tree/9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b
Attribution: InvokeAI contributors, Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-InvokeAI.txt).

Modifications: native Diffusers img2img subclass captures one call's source,
schedule and frozen CPU noise; preceding callbacks restore protected latents
before the next evaluation and before final VAE decode. Source mask polarity,
strict threshold and F32-inversion-before-dtype-conversion are preserved.
Copied inputs, finite/shape checks and finally cleanup bound internal execution.
This adaptation does not enable public outpaint or introduce another backend.

Modifications: copied caller-owned RGB/keep-mask inputs, request-local captured
normalized original/noise, shared native six-method loop hooks and finite/shape
guards. Inverse-shift threshold, shifted noise mixture, low-precision operation
ordering and Heun completion gating are preserved. Existing IGS authored/clipped
LCM schedules and zero-strength VAE-only execution remain intentional differences.
No public command, auxiliary download or persistent model mask state is added.

Consulted callers at that revision:
invokeai/app/invocations/text_encoder/compel.py (SDXLPromptInvocationBase.run_clip_compel)
invokeai/app/invocations/sd/denoise_latents.py (DenoiseLatentsInvocation LoRA scope).
The ordered stack prepares both CLIPs and UNet before their original consumers.
Modifications: existing exact safe Kohya snapshots/native target qualification,
whole-stack preflight, serialized/workspace bounds and finite-value refusals.
Equal-rank bias-free FP32 residuals, signed alpha/rank scaling, model-dtype cast
and sequential out-of-place Parameter.data addition preserve the direct path.
Only a fresh job-owned pipeline is mutated before regional borrowing; no cached
originals, restoration scope, sidecar modules or PEFT adapter is introduced.
Failure discards that owned pipeline and makes no borrowed-caller rollback promise.

Modifications: ordinary exact external loading and Auto/manual policy retain
their owners. Compute dtype is applied to the fresh job-owned VAE before regional
borrowing. The original native pipeline supplies terminal latents, then this
adaptation casts latents before scaling and calls the original native VAE once.
Finite guards precede normalization/clamp and existing RGB publication. Native
upcast/restore is not applied to borrowed VAE storage. No copied diffusion loop,
model copy, fallback, tiling, default change or private-profile promotion is added.

InvokeAI Standard SDXL regional reference-image inference

ImageGen Studio's ../illustrious_regional_references.py and the image insertion
in ../illustrious_regional_attention_adapter.py adapt these InvokeAI sources:
invokeai/app/invocations/sd/ip_adapter.py
invokeai/app/invocations/sd/denoise_latents.py
invokeai/backend/stable_diffusion/extensions/ip_adapter.py
invokeai/backend/stable_diffusion/diffusion/custom_atttention.py
invokeai/backend/stable_diffusion/diffusion/regional_ip_data.py

invokeai/backend/ip_adapter/ip_attention_weights.py
Consulted frontend callers: workbench/widgets/canvas/invoke/prepareCanvasInvocation.ts,
features/generation/core/canvas/addRegionalGuidance.ts and compileCanvasGraph.ts.
All at InvokeAI commit4875d96531ca6712b288f6e660fcbb34143408c1,
https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI/tree/4875d96531ca6712b288f6e660fcbb34143408c1
Attribution: InvokeAI contributors, Apache License2.0 (LICENSE-InvokeAI.txt).

Modifications: fixed exact offline ViT-H/Standard resources, bounded original PNG
snapshots with owning masks, standalone vision/projection before UNet loading,
full native attention registry binding and independent ordered image SDPA terms
inside the existing native processor's output-projection seam. CFG projects the
zero vision vector for unconditional image tokens independently of negative text.
The finite profile uses full/scale1/all steps, no generic adapter UI or Plus path.
Separate exact TXT/IMG/OUT reference profiles retain compileCanvasGraph's existing
image-to-latents/strength and alpha-outpaint grafts, then use that same regional
attention owner; original TXT profile semantics and native samplers are unchanged.
